meta.name: get-available-resources
meta.description: Detect host inventory and effective CPU, memory, disk, scheduler, container, and accelerator limits when a user asks for resource-aware planning or before a clearly resource-sensitive local workload. Produces a redacted JSON snapshot and conservative planning helpers without stress tests or assuming visible host hardware is usable.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检测主机资源限制并输出JSON快照
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要了解本地机器资源限制后再运行任务
copy.tagline_en: Detect host resource limits and output JSON snapshot
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to know your local machine's resource limits before running tasks

howto.what: 在计算密集型任务开始前,自动检测CPU核心、内存、磁盘和GPU等资源,生成一个`.claude_resources.json`文件,包含资源信息和并行处理、内存策略、GPU加速等推荐,并据此调整计算方案。
howto.when: 当用户提出计算密集型任务(如大数据量分析、模型训练、并行处理大量文件),或明确要求做资源感知规划时触发。

say.text: 帮我检测一下当前机器的CPU和内存,再决定怎么处理这个50GB基因组数据。
say.note: 会生成资源快照并提供大数据处理建议。

say.text: 我要训练神经网络,先看看有没有GPU和可用的加速后端。
并行处理10000个文件,根据资源给出最优worker数。
say.note: 根据核心数推荐joblib/Dask等设置。

howto.what_en: Before computationally intensive tasks, automatically detects CPU, memory, disk, and GPU resources, writes a `.claude_resources.json` snapshot with resource data and recommendations for parallel processing, memory strategy, and GPU acceleration, then adjusts the computation plan accordingly.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a user proposes computationally intensive work such as large-scale data analysis, model training, or parallel processing, or explicitly asks for resource-aware planning.

say_en.text: Check the machine's CPU and memory first, then decide how to handle this 50GB genomics dataset.
say_en.note: Generates a resource snapshot and big-data advice.

say_en.text: I want to train a neural network—first see if a GPU and available acceleration backends exist.
say_en.note: Detects NVIDIA/AMD/Apple Silicon and suggests libraries.

say_en.text: Process 10,000 files in parallel; give me the optimal worker count based on resources.
say_en.note: Recommends joblib/Dask settings from core count.
